content: Two open-source macOS menu bar tools display ChatGPT Plus/Codex quota: (1) withLinda/CodexPlusBar (Swift, updated Aug 2026) - authenticates via Chrome session cookies imported into WKWebsiteDataStore + ChatGPT-Account-ID header, calls backend-api/wham/usage, decodes primary_window (5H) + secondary_window (7D) with used_percent and reset_at, shows two meters and 'resets in Xh Ym' countdown; (2) liamlai88/ai-usage-bar (Python, May 2026) - reads ~/.codex/auth.json access_token, Bearer auth with Originator: codex_cli + User-Agent: codex_cli/0 headers, same endpoint, plus credits.balance and limit_reached. Both confirm the endpoint and window schema. Neither uses the OpenAI platform API.
